technical.summary: Mixed technical setup with short-term bullish RSI/MACD signals conflicting with weak trend strength (ADX 16.78), stochastic bearish cross, and price below Ichimoku cloud; insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 31 days—insufficient smart money alignment for actionable signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (335.2) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational healthcare revenues, and earnings in 31 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 16.78), stochastic bearish cross, price below Ichimoku cloud, no strategy triggers, zero insider conviction, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels, and earnings event risk within 31 days create overwhelming confluence of rejection signals.
